svg.title: Atlas full architecture
svg.desc: Complete technical architecture showing voice input through LiveKit and GPT-4.1-mini intent parsing (LiveKit Inference), routing to three paths: world generation via Qwen and the HY-World 2.0 five-stage pipeline, scene iteration via Qwen-Image editing and WorldMirror reconstruction with a visible iteration loop, and object placement via Hunyuan 3.1. All converge to three.js rendering with a Cartesia TTS response.
